switchPendingNextTurn: Takes effect on the next turn

descriptions.build: The default agent. Executes tools based on configured permissions.
descriptions.codexReadOnly: Codex can read files in the current workspace. Approval is required to edit files or access the internet.
descriptions.plan: Plan mode. Disallows all edit tools.
descriptions.codexAuto: Codex can read and edit files in the current workspace, and run commands. Approval is required to access the internet or edit other files. (Identical to Agent mode)
descriptions.codexFullAccess: Codex can edit files outside this workspace and access the internet without asking for approval. Exercise caution when using.
